title: A neutral allele can take over
hook: Two stated cases: explore the initial frequency under a neutral finite-population model.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the initial frequency under a neutral finite-population model affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Probability, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the initial frequency under a neutral finite-population model in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
